description: Set ONE product's title and selling points for Amazon, in the language of the workspace's Amazon marketplace (amazon.it → Italian). The title keeps to 75 characters (the workspace's rule — a product whose own name is longer cannot be listed without it); up to 5 points of at most 500 characters. Write only what the user stated or approved, in the marketplace's language. title null and no points removes them, and Amazon then gets the product name and characteristics. Saved in the CRM only: a new listing carries them; an existing offer gets them through update_amazon_listing_content with parts ["texts"]. Idempotent. The result echoes the workspace.

bulletPoints.description: Up to 5 selling points, in order; empty strings are dropped.

productId.description: A product id returned by search_products.

title.description: The Amazon title, at most 75 characters; null to use the product name.

name: set_amazon_listing_texts
title: Set Amazon title and points
